# VersionPlugin

> Gradle plugin (`io.github.alorma.version`) that sets versionName / versionCode (Android apps) or project.version (Android libraries, Kotlin Multiplatform) from a `version.properties` file. Published on the Gradle Plugin Portal.

## Using the plugin

- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/VersionPlugin/main/docs/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md): setup, version format, form factors, tasks, common mistakes. Start here.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/VersionPlugin/main/README.md)

## Working on the plugin itself

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/VersionPlugin/main/AGENTS.md): architecture, build and test commands, conventions.

## Optional

- [formFactor design notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alorma/VersionPlugin/main/docs/version-code-offset.md)
